task: Convert the BIOS Steward prototype into a static synthetic governance preview
audience: Open-source safety, evidence, privacy, and product reviewers

direction.keep: Editorial clarity, restrained typography, visible maturity and safety state
direction.avoid: Fake health metrics, interactive medical controls, authority mascots, or decorative clinical claims
direction.system: Fraunces and Figtree with grain, high-contrast governance cards, and reduced-motion support

asset_quality.why_premium: The exact UI system is the correct medium for a source-review surface; it does not depend on decorative generated health imagery.

score.note: Static composition and source quality pass; build and actual desktop/mobile export inspection remain blocked by machine preflight.
